h1: Custom Wood Door Hangers for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Wood Door Hangers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom wood door hangers in bulk for your next event or campaign. Durable, natural finish. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Wood door hangers offer a natural, premium feel that plastic or paper alternatives can't match. Whether you're promoting a hotel, real estate agency, or event, the warm grain of wood communicates quality and durability. These hangers accept full-color screen printing or laser engraving, making them ideal for detailed logos or elegant text. Bulk orders are cut from smooth, unfinished maple or pine, ready for your custom design.
heroAltText: Stack of custom wood door hangers with engraved logo on natural wood grain surface
